reviews.text: The S.A.G.E. Therapy Center in Carlsbad has been incredibly helpful and supportive with my personal growth. The attentive therapists genuinely listen and provide strong life-guiding tools that have made a significant difference in my daily life. Each appointment, I leave feeling more grounded and equipped to handle challenges that may come my way. To anyone seeking genuine, mental health support… I highly reccomend their services!

Kristin has been an amazing therapist. She has helped me navigate multiple relationships personal struggles and practice skills that have been valuable in all areas of my life. I can’t recommend her enough.

If you're looking for a therapist who truly listens and helps you move forward, look no further.

From the very first session, Kristin stood out as someone who is not only highly articulate, but genuinely skilled at seeing all sides of a situation without judgment. In a world where it's easy to feel unheard, Kristin has a rare gift for making you feel understood while also holding space for the perspectives of others involved.

What I appreciated most was that our sessions never felt like just venting into a void. Kristin consistently guided our conversations toward productive, actionable resolutions. She has a thoughtful, balanced approach that cuts through the noise and helps you walk away with real clarity and concrete next steps.

Sage Therapy itself is a welcoming and professional environment. Whether you're navigating a personal challenge, a relationship dynamic, or just trying to get unstuck, I can't recommend her highly enough.

Kristin has been an invaluable part of our lives for over 15 years. She’s guided us through challenges both big and small, and what I appreciate most is that even when we come in just for a “check-in,” we always leave with clarity and resolution.
I’ve seen her individually, with my husband for couples therapy, and our children have also benefited from her support. She creates a safe, welcoming space for each of us, no matter what stage of life we’re in or what we’re facing.
Kristin’s approach is refreshingly solution-focused and self-paced—she never pressures you to come more than you need. It’s empowering to know that she's there when we need her, and that support brings such peace of mind.
Over the years, I’ve referred many friends and family members to her, and every one of them has shared the same deep appreciation for her insight, compassion, and wisdom.
Simply put, having Kristin as our therapist has been one of the greatest gifts in our lives.

Working with Kristen has been very supportive and grounding for me. I came into therapy for help with all types of relationships and boundaries, and also anxiety.  In our work together I’ve gained a much stronger understanding of relationship dynamics and how to find balance without abandoning myself.

She has a way of being gentle while still asking the hard, necessary questions. I always felt supported, seen, and respected, even when the work was challenging. Her approach is practical, calm, and deeply wise, and it helped me build stronger boundaries and more confidence in myself.

I would highly recommend her to anyone who appreciates a direct, thoughtful approach and is ready to do meaningful inner work
